sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports and current role
sections.what: Loads the image, map, label, and data pieces. Then selects the role to show in the facts table: the one marked as current, or the first one if none is marked.
sections.why: The header stays correct when the job changes, as long as the current entry is marked in the data.
sections.watch_out: If no entry is marked CURRENT, the first entry in the list is shown, which may not be the newest role.

sections.name: Hero
sections.title: Introduction block and jump links
sections.what: Builds the header: the facts table, the portrait, the name, the descriptor, the current status line, and three jump links. The knowledge map sits in the wider column on the right.
sections.why: Gives visitors the key facts and a route to the sections they most likely want.
sections.watch_out: The jump links point to fixed section identifiers. Renaming a section identifier breaks its link.

summary: The top of the home page: a portrait, name, one-line description, a short facts table, jump links to other sections, and a knowledge map.
purpose: Gives a first impression and the key facts at a glance.
why: Likely reason: the facts come from data files, so the summary stays current when the data changes.
how: Picks the current role (the one marked CURRENT, or the first if none is marked). Builds four fact rows: role, location, education, and number of AI builds. Shows the portrait and name, and places the knowledge map beside them.
inputs: The battles list, the education record, the AI builds list, the site data, and the portrait image details.
outputs: The introduction block with a facts table, a portrait, and jump links to AI builds, Experience, and Curiosities.
risks: If the battles list is empty, the code reads a property from a missing value and the page fails. The build count updates automatically when the list changes.
debug: If the top of the home page fails, check the battles and education data files for empty lists or missing fields.
